About Me

Security-first,
Full-stack mindset

I'm Yashika Bansal, a 2nd-year B.Tech student at Vellore Institute of Technology specialising in Computer Science & Engineering (Information Security). I maintain a CGPA of 8.5/10.

My approach is simple: every application I build treats security as a first-class concern — not an afterthought. I've shipped AES-256 encrypted vaults, multi-layer 2FA systems, and zero-framework SPAs — all live in production.

Two internships completed. Six live-deployed applications. Trilingual — English, Hindi, and Spanish.

"I don't just write features. I architect systems that are production-ready, secure, and built to last."
